method_name: Weighted arithmetic WQI with inverse-limit weights
purpose: Drinking-water-standard-aligned groundwater screening WQI, not a legal compliance determination.
standard_source: German Drinking Water Ordinance (TrinkwV), Anlage 2 and Anlage 3, accessed 2026-09-16.

EC.note: TrinkwV reference is 25 °C. The source workbooks do not state the EC reference temperature; this calculation assumes the reported values are comparable to 25 °C.

pH.note: Two-sided pH quality rating: deviation from 7 is divided by the distance to the relevant TrinkwV boundary.
